About Launthia

Meet Launthia

Launthia Watson is a luxury destination bridal makeup artist based in Jamaica, and the artist behind Glow by Launthia.

Through Glow by Launthia she offers three signature services: Soft Glam, Full Glam and Bridal Glam. From brides and their bridal parties to birthdays and photoshoots, every look is created by appointment only and booked directly with Launthia on WhatsApp.

Her work is followed by 69.4k people on Instagram at @glow_by_launthia, where she shares her finished looks and the moments in the chair behind them.
